## Interview Brief

Write a few sentences on what you want to learn. The AI drafts the **aims**, and a **study designer** sets how the interviews run: what people see at the end (their result with evidence, a short result, or just thanks), how warm the interviewer may be before it skews answers, whether the style adapts to each person, warm-up questions, length, and which tools it may use.

Participants pick who to talk to (Mei, Sam or Pip come in the box) and start a chat. Two studies are included: **Which of the 16 types are you?** (a fun self-reflection) and **Our Taste Test** (what makes an app screen feel right, with 18 real screens).
attributes.cardDescription: A research study as a brief: what you want to learn, the aims, the must-ask questions, the study design, and which interviewers people can pick. Participants start here.
